intent_contract.text: 은꼴사에 초점을 맞춰서 컨셉 만들어서 다시 한번 독립된 환경의 서브에이전트에서 테스트해줘.

Create and independently test a photographic concept whose focal effect is understated, non-explicit suggestiveness arising from an ordinary adult fashion-adjustment moment, with the visual cause readable rather than implied by a label.

Create a vertical photorealistic editorial photograph in a late-night independent boutique fitting salon between appointments, built around an ordinary adult fashion-adjustment event with a visible causal boundary change. Show one unmistakably adult woman from head to upper thighs, with visible adult facial proportions, long dark wavy hair, and visible natural skin texture. She wears an opaque ivory satin camisole with wide bound straps, a squared neckline, architectural bust seams, and a clearly visible lower hem under a separate midnight-navy linen-silk tailored suit jacket with lapels, front edges, one button, and a clean inner lining. Her right thumb and forefinger lift the precise waist-height corner of the jacket's left front edge to settle its overlap, paused before release. The lifted outer edge changes the clothing boundary in the same frame and reveals a narrow diagonal strip of bare waist between the camisole hem and high-rise trouser waistband. Keep her hand, the exact jacket edge, the changed boundary, the bounded waist interval, and both garment hems visibly connected as one causal relation. Closing that edge would cover the waist interval while the opaque camisole would remain visibly separate at the neckline and lapel opening. Place a transparent acrylic garment screen behind her, crossed by one reflected ceiling strip, while her real face, real hand, and real torso remain traceable. Make her face the first thumbnail focal read and the hand-altered boundary the second. Use diffuse rainy daylight with one warm practical glow, photographed vertically at eye level with a 55 mm lens. Preserve realistic satin sheen, linen-silk grain, seam relief, overlap direction, contact shadow, and natural skin texture.

Size and place the matched instances so their shared rule can be inferred from the image without prompt text or a caption, and keep every unaffected hand, face, object boundary, material, perspective, and light response convincingly ordinary. Choose a deliberate reveal strength: either an immediate authored contradiction or a quiet second-look contradiction. In either mode, it must read as one integrated world system rather than a visible effect shell, portal, particle dissolve, or generic image failure.
